facts.function: general cutting of cardboard, plastic and other materials
facts.form: manually operated folding utility knife with locking replaceable blade, quick-change system, attached screwdriver, spare blade

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8211 covers knives with cutting blades, serrated or not; chapter 82 note excludes nothing relevant; replaceable-blade knife is not a tool of 8205
GRI 3(b): the attached screwdriver is subsidiary; the folding knife gives essential character; the spare blade is classified with the knife
GRI 6: 8211.93 knives having other than fixed blades; 8211.93.00.35 pen knives, pocket knives and other knives which have folding blades

rejected_alternatives.reason: the blade folds into the handle, so the folding-blade line is more specific
screwdriver is a minor attached feature; knife function predominates

classification.rationale: The item is a folding utility knife with a locking, replaceable blade, which is a knife having other than a fixed blade in heading 8211. The attached screwdriver and spare blade do not change its essential character as a knife. CBP classified a materially identical manually operated folding utility knife in 8211.93.0035 (N361367, in force).
